policy_prompt_for_memory.description: If the scene at this decision step (the last frame shown) shows loose cubes and no containers anywhere (the scene before the button is pressed), read the goal instruction, list the cubes it names in the order it names them, and write the [y, x] of each of those cubes as an ordered list in that same order; leave out any cube the goal does not name. Otherwise copy the carried-in list unchanged, never editing it from a cube briefly exposed under a lifted container. e.g. goal naming blue then red: [[78, 157], [106, 105]]; goal naming only red: [[73, 93]]

annotator_prompt.description: An ordered list of the [y, x] positions, read at step #1 (t=0) while the three cubes are still loose and no container is on the table, of exactly the cubes the goal instruction names, in the order the goal names them. Cubes the goal does not name are not recorded. Written at step #1 and held unchanged for the rest of the episode, even after a container comes down over a cube or a lifted container briefly re-exposes one; a re-exposed cube never overwrites an entry. The entry at index picks_done is the cube whose container is picked next. e.g. for a goal naming the blue cube then the red cube: [[78, 157], [106, 105]]; for a goal naming only the red cube: [[73, 93]]
